title: BR-026 vessel repair: a small gap in a connected network
claim: The retained BR-026 V01 Terra/high attempt recovered 198 of 200 authored gap voxels with no other edits. Nine logged threshold counts, 32/33-voxel contact patches, the saved mask, and all 12 frozen verifier checks reproduce from retained evidence.
limitations: Synthetic deletion in real MRA; one successful calibration attempt, not natural segmentation-error difficulty or clinical validation.
Threshold states are deterministic reconstructions from recorded settings; reader controls are not an agent screen recording.
Observed image use does not establish necessity without a matched image-ablation experiment.
The companion unchanged-mask reference disagreement remains unresolved; frozen scores are unchanged.
